'''Damian Loback Huntsville AL 03-02-02 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Damian Loback]] posted on DeckTech on 3 March 2002 about [[March 2002 Huntsville tournament]].<ref name="tr-d3421">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-03-huntsville-al-03-02-02d3421/ huntsville-al-03-02-02], DeckTech (Damian "Jamintheeye" Loback, 3 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-03-huntsville-al-03-02-02d3421/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Damian Loback went 2–1 with a bye at a tournament in Huntsville, Alabama, on 2 March 2002, losing to Andy's Senate deck with his Build the Death Star deck and beating Chris McClure and Efrige with X-wing Hidden Base.

* '''Record:''' 2–1
* '''Points:''' 6 (+37)
* '''Dark deck:''' Build the Death Star with shields
* '''Light deck:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|X-wings Hidden Base flip]]
